b2-brasilsudeste-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Why São Paulo Grew
b2-brasilsudeste-01.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are watching a documentary about São Paulo, and she asks how the city got rich in the 19th century.
b2-brasilsudeste-01.prompt: Tell Meg how São Paulo became rich, then say the same thing more plainly.
cues: Say that the city grew thanks to coffee
Restate it: coffee money paid for the railway
b2-brasilsudeste-01.target: São Paulo creció gracias al café; es decir, el dinero del café pagó el ferrocarril.
b2-brasilsudeste-01.english: São Paulo grew thanks to coffee; that is, the coffee money paid for the railway.
b2-brasilsudeste-01.canDo: I can restate an idea about São Paulo with *es decir*, *o sea* or *en otras palabras*.

b2-brasilsudeste-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Hills and Bay
b2-brasilsudeste-02.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are planning a trip and reading about Rio de Janeiro, and he asks what you learned about the royal court.
b2-brasilsudeste-02.prompt: Tell Carlos which city the Portuguese royal family settled in during 1808.
cues: Say that it was a city, using a relative clause
Give the year the family arrived
b2-brasilsudeste-02.target: La ciudad donde se instaló la familia real portuguesa en 1808 era Río de Janeiro.
b2-brasilsudeste-02.english: The city where the Portuguese royal family settled in 1808 was Rio de Janeiro.
b2-brasilsudeste-02.canDo: I can describe places in Rio with relative clauses such as *que*, *donde* and *cuyo*.

b2-brasilsudeste-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Week of 1922
b2-brasilsudeste-03.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are preparing a short talk on Brazilian modernism, and she asks when the Modern Art Week took place.
b2-brasilsudeste-03.prompt: Tell Meg when and where the Modern Art Week was held, using a passive with *se*.
cues: Say that it was held in São Paulo
b2-brasilsudeste-03.target: La Semana de Arte Moderna se celebró en São Paulo en 1922.
b2-brasilsudeste-03.english: The Modern Art Week was held in São Paulo in 1922.
b2-brasilsudeste-03.canDo: I can tell the different jobs of *se* in a text about the Modern Art Week of 1922.

b2-brasilsudeste-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Bossa Nova Facts
b2-brasilsudeste-04.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are listening to bossa nova and he thinks it came from the favelas.
b2-brasilsudeste-04.prompt: Correct Carlos: bossa nova began in apartments in the south of Rio.
cues: Correct what he assumes, with a stance adverb
b2-brasilsudeste-04.target: En realidad, la bossa nova nació en apartamentos de la zona sur de Río.
b2-brasilsudeste-04.english: In fact, bossa nova began in apartments in the south of Rio.
b2-brasilsudeste-04.canDo: I can add my view of a fact about Brazilian music with adverbs such as *en realidad* and *precisamente*.

b2-brasilsudeste-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Learning Portuguese
b2-brasilsudeste-05.scenario: You are Meg. You are telling Carlos how learning Portuguese is going after reading about the neighbour languages.
b2-brasilsudeste-05.prompt: Tell Carlos that the more you read in Portuguese, the more you understand.
b2-brasilsudeste-05.target: Cuanto más leo en portugués, más entiendo.
b2-brasilsudeste-05.english: The more I read in Portuguese, the more I understand.
b2-brasilsudeste-05.canDo: I can link two changes about learning Portuguese with *cuanto más ..., más ...* and *a medida que*.

b2-brasilsudeste-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Brazil in Review
b2-brasilsudeste-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are preparing a short talk about Brazil's southeast, and she asks you to explain what the coffee railway meant for São Paulo.
b2-brasilsudeste-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg that coffee made São Paulo rich, then say it again in other words.
cues: Say that coffee made the city rich
b2-brasilsudeste-consolidation.target: El café hizo rica a São Paulo; en otras palabras, la ciudad creció gracias al café.
b2-brasilsudeste-consolidation.english: Coffee made São Paulo rich; in other words, the city grew thanks to coffee.
b2-brasilsudeste-consolidation.canDo: I can restate an idea about Brazil with *es decir*, *o sea* or *en otras palabras*.
